about_the_game:
Solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and uncover the chilling truth to escape the asylum.

A young woman named Sophie awakens in the cold, dimly lit halls of a mental hospital—her past a blank slate. No memory. No explanation. Only an overwhelming need to escape. As she stumbles through the eerie corridors, whispers fill the air, and shadowy figures lurk beyond every door. "I have to get out..." she tells herself, stepping into the unknown.

To break free, she must unlock doors, solve intricate escape puzzles, and piece together fragments of her shattered past. But the deeper she goes, the more she realizes—something or someone is determined to keep her inside.

🧩 ESCAPE FROM MENTAL HOSPITAL FEATURES 🧩

🧠 Mind-Bending Puzzles – Solve logic-based challenges to progress.

🕵️ Hidden Objects with Renewable hints & skips – Seek and find key items to aid your escape.

😱 Meet Unusual Patients – Encounter the asylum’s eerie inhabitants.

🕰️ Unravel the Story – Discover who Sophie really is—and why she’s trapped.

🔄 Engaging Game Mechanics – A thrilling blend of adventure and escape-room gameplay.

With every door she unlocks, Sophie inches closer to the truth. But time is running out. With sinister forces lurking around every corner, will she escape… or become just another lost soul within the asylum?

The answers are waiting. The only question is—can you escape?

content_descriptors.notes:
Escape from Mental Hospital features psychological horror elements, dark environments, and themes related to mental illness. The game includes unsettling atmosphere, anxiety-driven scenes, and interactions with distressed patients.

There is no gore, no graphic violence, no sexual content, and no depictions of self-harm or drug abuse.
